assembly: Concatenate sharedStyle, two newlines, viewportInstructions[viewport], two newlines, 'Screen content and layout:\n', and screenInstructions[tab].

inputRoles.role: Existing draft for workflow and content. Read the pre-replacement version from Git.

sharedStyle:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Make one polished, pixel-sharp BracketIQ application screen as a generated UI reference. This is a clean flat screen, not a device photo or a poster.
Input image 1 is the old screen: preserve the required workflow, content and data, but rebuild the layout so nothing is clipped or misaligned. Input image 2 is the approved BracketIQ commerce screen: use its precise navy typography, compact component design and orange/teal brand language.
Match current custom BracketIQ tokens: EVERY rectangular card, button, text field, badge, tab segment and dialog has the same subtle 8px corner radius at desktop scale. No pills, no oversized rounded cards. Only avatars and radio marks may be circular. Use Roboto Flex-like sans serif, bold navy headings, clean regular body text, near-white canvas (#fafafa), pure white surfaces, thin cool-grey borders (#dde0e5), restrained 1px shadows, navy #071a38, orange brand accents #ff5735, deep burnt-orange filled primary controls around #bb4024 with white text, teal #078793 for selected/complete states, pale teal and pale violet state backgrounds. Use accurate crisp line icons.
Spacing: 8px rhythm, generous inner padding, clear baseline alignment, aligned control heights, tabular right-aligned numbers. All copy must be fully visible inside its container, with space between labels and fields. No ellipses, no clipped words, no colliding text. Wrap secondary copy or shorten it exactly as specified. No small eyebrow labels above page, event, team or organization names. Do not add draft captions or implementation commentary inside the product.
Shared header: thin orange top edge, navy navigation bar with menu icon, white "BracketIQ" wordmark, notification bell, circular "MR" avatar. White event header: "Fall Tip-Off Classic"; below it "Austin Hoops · Austin Sports Center · Oct 10–11, 2026"; next row a rectangular pale teal "Published" badge plus "24 teams · 3 courts". No text above the event name. Then the six existing tabs in this exact order: "Details", "Participants", "Schedule", "Standings", "Bracket", "Finance". One active tab has orange text and a thin orange underline.
Do not change any registration, scoring, finance or schedule behavior. Render all supplied text exactly. Omit incidental unnecessary text rather than inventing words.

viewportInstructions.desktop: Output one landscape image, 1536 × 1024. The complete screen must fit inside the image, with at least 32px of space below the final element. Header bar about 64px high. Event header about 125px, tabs 52px. Main content uses 48px outer margins, 24px gutters. Body type 15–17px, card titles 20–22px, page title 28px. Keep all six tabs on one row. Place a compact "Normal | Manage" rectangular segmented mode control at the right of the page heading.
viewportInstructions.mobile: Output one portrait image with aspect ratio 853:1844, target 853 × 1844. This is a mobile website screen. Fit complete sections with at least 32px bottom safe margin. Use 32px outer margins and 20–24px gaps. Mobile typography must be legible: title around 34px, body 22–24px, supporting type no smaller than 18px at this reference resolution. The navy bar is about 88px tall. Wrap the event subtitle into two lines if needed. The six tabs form a clean 3-column, 2-row tab grid (Details, Participants, Schedule / Standings, Bracket, Finance), with equal tap targets; keep every tab label fully visible. This is responsive wrapping of the same six tabs. Below the tabs, align page title and rectangular "Normal | Manage" mode control without collision. Use one column for the main content. Avoid shrinking a desktop screen into mobile.

screenInstructions.details: Active tab Details; Manage mode selected. Title "Event overview". Six sections. "Event status & dates": "Oct 10–11, 2026", "Saturday–Sunday · Central time", "Basketball", "Pool play + bracket". "Event actions": primary "Manage event"; secondary "Update event" and "View public page". "1 schedule conflict": "Court 2 · 11:00 AM"; "#M05 and #M06 overlap."; "Review conflict". "Venue & resources": "Austin Sports Center"; "3 courts reserved"; "Court 1", "Court 2", "Court 3" in small outlined rectangular controls. "Registration readiness": "24 teams registered"; "2 divisions · 4 teams need attention"; teal progress bar "20 / 24 ready". "Next operational milestones": three aligned rows "Registration closes" / "Oct 2"; "Publish final schedule" / "Oct 7"; "Team check-in opens" / "Oct 10 · 8:00 AM". Desktop: two-column 3-row grid, wider left column has dates, venue, readiness; right has actions, conflict, milestones. Mobile: stack dates, actions, conflict, venue, readiness, milestones; keep card heights compact so all fit.
screenInstructions.participants: Active tab Participants; Manage mode selected. Heading "Participants"; subtitle "24 teams registered · 2 divisions"; primary "Add team". Summary strip: "24 Registered", "20 Ready", "4 Need attention". Search "Team name or contact", filters "All divisions", "All statuses". "Registered teams" table on desktop, stacked team rows on mobile. Use these three visible records: "Austin Hoops 12U" / "12U Boys · Maya Rivera" / "Complete" / "Paid"; "Cedar Park Elite" / "12U Boys · Jordan Brooks" / "Roster pending" / "Due $150"; "Round Rock Rebels" / "14U Boys · Elena Garcia" / "Complete" / "Paid". First team selected with pale teal background and slim teal left border. Detail card titled "Austin Hoops 12U": "Maya Rivera", "FT-1042 · 10 players", teal status "Registration complete · $350 paid", primary "View registration". Desktop detail card beside the table. Mobile detail below three team rows. Bottom separate empty-state example card with title "No teams registered yet", description "Add the first team to start registration.", secondary "Add team". Do not put an eyebrow above this heading. Keep clear visual separation between the example and populated list.
screenInstructions.schedule:
Active tab Schedule; Manage mode selected. Title "Schedule"; subtitle "Drag matches to reschedule them." Filters: "Division" above "14U Boys"; "Pool" above "Pool A"; rectangular segmented "Calendar | By court" with By court active; outline "Lock all matches". Day navigation "Saturday, Oct 10" with left/right arrow buttons; subtitle "CDT". Two compact time-range badges: "9:00 AM–2:00 PM" and "4:00 PM–8:00 PM", with "2:00–4:00 PM break" clearly placed on its own line or between them. NO visible-hour slider.
Main calendar has time gutter and exactly three evenly spaced columns titled "Court 1", "Court 2", "Court 3". Rows: "9:00 AM", "10:00 AM", "11:00 AM", "12:00 PM", then full-width hatched "2:00–4:00 PM break", then "4:00 PM". At 9:00 Court 1 a card "Austin Hoops" with "9:00 AM". At 10:00 Court 2 card "Match #M05" with "10:00–11:30 AM". At 11:00 Court 2 orange outline card "Match #M06" with "11:00 AM · Moving"; same row Court 3 a CLEAR AVAILABLE white dashed orange drop target "Drop here" and a small directional arrow from M06 toward it. At 12:00 Court 1 card "Westlake Titans" / "12:00 PM". At 4:00 Courts 1 and 3 grey hatched blocks "Unavailable", and Court 2 pale teal open cell "Open drop area". Grey hatched blocks must never say Drop here. Calendar cards must sit entirely within the correct row and column.
Conflict alert: "1 schedule conflict"; "#M05 and #M06 overlap on Court 2 at 11:00 AM."; outline "Review conflict".
Separate component-state examples, titled "Schedule states", with three spaced rows: "Loading" / "Fetching matches…"; "Empty" / "No matches for these filters."; "Error" / "Schedule did not load." / "Retry".
Desktop: wide calendar left and narrow right column with conflict and state examples, generous grid row heights. Mobile: full-width compact filters, then calendar, conflict, then state examples. Use compact match identifiers in narrow cells and readable supporting text. All section titles and controls must have their own space.
screenInstructions.standings: Active tab Standings; Manage mode selected. Title "Standings"; subtitle "Review pool rankings and confirm results." Controls "Division" / "14U Boys"; "Pool" / "Pool A". Teal success banner "All pool matches recorded" / "6 of 6 complete". "Pool A rankings" with four teams. Columns "#" / "Team" / "W" / "L" / "Diff." / "Pts". Rows: 1 Austin Hoops 3 0 +34 9; 2 Northside United 2 1 +12 6; 3 Cedar Park 1 2 −8 3; 4 Hill Country 0 3 −38 0. First row selected, pale teal. Mobile convert table to readable ranked rows with team left, points right, W/L and difference on second line. Selected team adjustment card "Austin Hoops", "Rank 1 · 9 calculated points", labelled number stepper "Final points" value "9", text "Changes apply only when saved.", disabled button "Save standings adjustments". Recent result: "Austin Hoops" "48 – 42" "Northside United"; "Final · Court 2 · 3:10 PM". Confirmation card "Confirm Pool A results", checked checkbox "Apply automatic playoff reassignment", supporting text "May update playoff placements.", primary "Confirm results". Desktop rankings and recent result left, adjustment and confirmation right. Mobile stack banner, rankings, adjustment, recent result, confirmation. Use proper singular/plural in W/L descriptions.
screenInstructions.bracket: Active tab Bracket; Normal mode selected. Title "Playoff bracket"; subtitle "Select a match to view the details." Filter "14U Boys · Gold". Clean bracket canvas with "Semifinals" and "Final" columns, connected with thin teal right-angle lines. Match 12: Austin Hoops 62 vs Northside United 54, complete. Match 13: Westlake Wolves 57 vs Eastside Eagles 51, complete. Match 15: Austin Hoops 32 vs Westlake Wolves 28, live. Teams and scores align in tidy rows, no text crosses connectors. Foreground centered match-details modal with 8px corners and modest shadow. Dim the ENTIRE background, including global header and tabs, uniformly with a translucent navy scrim. Modal title "Match 15 · Final", accessible square close icon top right, then "Court 1 · Sun, Oct 11 · 2:30 PM" and rectangular teal "Live" badge. Two equal score columns: "Austin Hoops" above "32", "Westlake Wolves" above "28". Large scores aligned on same baseline. Below, pale teal status bar "In progress · Q3 06:12". Full-width outline "Close" button at bottom with adequate padding. Modal has balanced compact spacing, not a huge empty white void. Desktop modal about 600px wide; enough bracket remains visible around it. Mobile modal inset 32px, large readable names and scores, may wrap date onto a second line. Underlying mobile bracket fits in width. No host statistics, no score editing, no finance or management widgets.
screenInstructions.finance: Active tab Finance; Manage mode selected. Heading "Finance"; subtitle "Registration payments and event costs"; secondary "Refresh". Four summary metrics: "Collected" "$9,450" "21 registration payments"; "Outstanding" "$1,350" "3 teams with balances"; "Refunds issued" "$450" "1 completed refund"; "Net revenue" "$9,000" "After confirmed refunds". Desktop four cards in a row; mobile a 2×2 grid with aligned values and descriptions. Main card "Registration payments", subtitle "24 registrations · 21 paid · 3 outstanding". Three rows: "Austin Sparks" / "14U Girls · Card · Oct 8" / "$450.00" / "Paid"; "Cedar Park Jets" / "12U Boys · Manual proof" / "$450.00" / "Needs review"; "Round Rock Raptors" / "14U Boys · Due Oct 9" / "$450.00" / "Outstanding". Desktop use search "Search registrations" and "All payment statuses" above table. Mobile omit filters to retain readable row content. Warning card "Payment status unavailable", "Cedar Park Jets · $450.00", "Manual proof could not load. The balance is unchanged.", outline action "Review payment". Staffing card "Day-of staffing", rectangular status "Planned"; "6 officials · 3 courts · Oct 10"; divider; "Planned staff cost" / "$720.00". Footer "Payment reviews never charge or refund automatically." Desktop payment table left, warning and staffing right. Mobile stack metrics, payment list, warning, staffing, footer. Align dollar amounts vertically. Do not add bank/card inputs, charts or auto-charge actions.
